name: vc-prompt-optimizer--local
description: Fully local prompt optimization, semantic cache, and token cost forecasting for VS Code. Your prompts and code never leave your machine — no telemetry, no cloud processing. Works with GitHub Copilot.

badges.description: Fully local — no data leaves your machine

chatParticipants.name: promptoptimizer
chatParticipants.description: Optimize prompts, answer questions with full conversation memory, and estimate token cost — all powered by your local workspace context

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Optimize the current prompt with local cache and editor context

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send the most recent optimized prompt to Copilot (after reviewing)

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Discard the pending optimized prompt without sending

commands.name: estimate

commands.name: clear

disambiguation.description: The user wants to compress a coding prompt, inspect local prompt context, or estimate token cost before asking Copilot.
examples: Optimize this prompt before I send it to Copilot
Estimate the token cost for this coding request
Show me what cached or buffered context Prompt Optimizer can use

promptProxy.support.email.markdownDescription: Override the support email used by the **Email author** action shown when an error occurs. Leave blank to use the value declared in the extension's `bugs.email` field.

promptProxy.targetModel.description: The compiler target model compiler style to optimize the prompt formatting layout for.

promptProxy.dbPath.description: Custom path for the local SQLite semantic cache database. If left blank, it defaults to the global storage path.

promptProxy.density.description: Output density for the structured prompt. 'rich' adds repo context and measurable constraints; 'lean' emits a minimal task line plus a single output-discipline constraint for the fewest tokens.

promptProxy.processingMode.description: Query processing mode for the cache lookup: 'blocking' stands for precise sequential execution; 'non-blocking' uses an async background lookup.

promptProxy.enableSessionContext.description: Feed recent user prompts and analysis results back as conversation-aware session history to the optimizer engine.

promptProxy.pricingInput.description: Input cost per 1K tokens in USD (defaults to $0.0015).

promptProxy.pricingOutput.description: Output cost per 1K tokens in USD (defaults to $0.002).

enumDescriptions: Copilot Business — 300 premium requests / month per seat.
Copilot Enterprise — 1000 premium requests / month per seat.
promptProxy.subscriptionPlan.description: Your GitHub Copilot subscription plan. Determines the monthly included premium-request (credit) allowance used by the forecast.

promptProxy.forecastRequestsPerDay.description: Estimated number of optimized requests you send per working day. Used to project monthly premium-request (credit) usage in the forecast.

promptProxy.creditOveragePrice.description: Price in USD charged per additional premium request once your monthly included allowance is exhausted (GitHub default $0.04 per request).

promptProxy.creditBaseInputRate.description: Base credit rate per input token (Rin) used by the forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditBaseOutputRate.description: Base credit rate per output token (Rout) used by the forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditFixedExecutionOverhead.description: Fixed execution overhead (Fe) added per request in the forecast formula.

promptProxy.forecastInputTokens.description: Fallback input-token count (Tin) used when no recent analysis is available.

promptProxy.forecastOutputTokens.description: Fallback output-token count (Tout) used when no recent analysis is available.

promptProxy.creditWeight.gpt.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for GPT in the credit forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditWeight.claude.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for Claude in the credit forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditWeight.gemini.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for Gemini in the credit forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditWeight.deepseek.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for DeepSeek in the credit forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditWeight.grok.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for Grok in the credit forecast formula.

promptProxy.creditWeight.local.description: Model complexity weight (Wm) for Local in the credit forecast formula (default 0 keeps local included).

promptProxy.enableSecretDetection.description: Scan prompts for potential secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) before sending and show a warning in the panel.

promptProxy.enableGrammarModel.description: Use the bundled on-device grammar model to polish the optimized prompt's wording, in addition to the always-on deterministic corrector. Every model rewrite is meaning-guarded (identifiers, numbers, negations and content words are preserved), so it can refine grammar but never change what the prompt asks for. Requires a model under models/grammar-correction (run `npm run fetch-grammar-model`).

promptProxy.confirmBeforeSend.description: When using @promptoptimizer in chat, show the optimized prompt and require explicit confirmation before forwarding to Copilot. Disable to send automatically (legacy behavior).

promptProxy.tokenBudget.augmentedBytes.description: Maximum total bytes of augmented context (workspace memory + knowledge graph + file digests + peer matches) injected into every optimized prompt. Lower this to reduce per-turn token cost; raise it for large codebases. Default 18000 (~4.5K tokens).

promptProxy.tokenBudget.managedBytes.description: Maximum bytes Prompt Optimizer is allowed to write inside its managed block in .github/copilot-instructions.md. Default 8000 (~2K tokens always-on).

promptProxy.tokenBudget.perFileBytes.description: Per-memory-file byte cap (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / .promptoptimizer/memory.md / etc.) when harvesting workspace memory for the engine. Default 12000.

promptProxy.tokenBudget.totalBytes.description: Total byte cap for the harvested workspace-memory block (sum across all memory files). Default 24000.

promptProxy.suppressWelcome.description: Suppress the post-install / post-update status-bar highlight and welcome toast.

promptProxy.versions.author.description: Author name recorded on prompt version commits (Git-style). Leave empty to use the OS username.

promptProxy.onboarding.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the Prompt Optimizer Guide on first install and after every extension update. Disable to suppress the auto-open (you can still launch it via the Visual Tour chip or the command palette).

promptProxy.optimize.autoOpenChat.description: When true, the Optimize action automatically opens Copilot Chat with the optimized prompt pre-filled (legacy behaviour). When false (default), the success toast offers a 'Send to Copilot Chat' button so chat only opens when you ask.

promptProxy.optimize.autoOpenContextFile.description: When true, after local analysis completes, Prompt Optimizer automatically opens the context files it selected and highlights the exact ranges used for optimization.

enumDescriptions: Use the first non-empty source in this order: selection → full editor → clipboard.
When both the editor selection and clipboard are non-empty AND differ, show a Quick Pick so you choose explicitly.
Always prefer the editor selection, fall back to clipboard, then full editor.
Always prefer the clipboard, fall back to selection, then full editor.
promptProxy.optimize.sourcePicker.description: Controls how the Optimize action picks its input when multiple sources are available.

promptProxy.collectTrainingData.description: Opt-in: append local prompt → optimized pairs to training-pairs.jsonl in the extension's global storage so you can fine-tune the bundled distilled model. Data never leaves your machine.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the warning (e.g. 'My internal token').

matchMode.description: How to evaluate the custom pattern against the full prompt text. 'regex' uses JavaScript regex, 'like' uses SQL LIKE semantics, and the other modes do case-insensitive string matching.

pattern.description: The raw match input. For 'regex', provide a JavaScript regex source without delimiters. For 'like', use SQL LIKE syntax. For string modes, provide the literal text to match.

promptProxy.secretPatterns.description: Additional custom secret-detection rules. Each entry must include a 'pattern', can optionally set 'matchMode' (regex | like | contains | startsWith | endsWith | exact), and can include a 'label'.

languageModelTools.name: prompt-optimizer_recallMemory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recalls long-lived workspace, user, and team memory persisted by Prompt Optimizer. Returns the most relevant notes from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .promptoptimizer/memory.md, the project knowledge graph, prior optimized prompts, and the user-global memory tier. Call this whenever the user asks about project conventions, prior decisions, related past prompts, framework choices, or anything that might be captured in long-lived project memory.

query.description: Topic, question, or keywords to find memory about. Leave empty to return the most recent general memory entries.

scope.description: Which memory tier to search. 'workspace' = this repo only, 'user' = the user-global tier shared across all repos, 'all' = both. Defaults to 'all'.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-50). Defaults to 8.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Prompt Optimizer
walkthroughs.description: Optimize prompts locally before sending to Copilot.

steps.title: Open the Prompt Optimizer panel
steps.description:
Click the Prompt Optimizer view in the Activity Bar (or press `Ctrl+Alt+P`).
[Open panel](command:prompt-proxy.focusPanel)

steps.title: Optimize your first prompt
steps.description:
Paste a prompt and press `Ctrl+Enter`, or hit the **Optimize** button in the status bar to optimize whatever is in your editor selection.
[Optimize now](command:prompt-proxy.optimizeChatPrompt)

steps.title: Pick a default mode
steps.description:
Agent answers directly, Optimize shows analysis, Direct pre-fills chat.
[Select mode](command:prompt-proxy.selectMode)

steps.title: Curate workspace memory
steps.description:
Drop notes into `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `.promptoptimizer/memory.md` — Prompt Optimizer will index them locally for richer prompts.
[Open memory file](command:prompt-proxy.openMemoryFile)
